title: LeetCode Fundamentals: Easy Interview Patterns
description: Six classic LeetCode-style interview problems in TypeScript, covering the core patterns you'll see over and over: hash maps, stacks, greedy one-pass scans, dynamic programming, and linked-list pointer manipulation.
